subject: Post-call: model fit & regression concerns after v1.3 rollout
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@acme-retail.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: model fit & regression concerns after v1.3 rollout

Thanks again for taking the call earlier, Taylor and Jordan — really helpful to walk through the current integration and the failure modes you flagged. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment:

Recap:
- Primary use case: returns classification and human-like reasoning for ambiguous descriptions (high precision required).
- Current pain: after "v1.3" model rollout on your production endpoint we discussed, you’re seeing an increase in false positives on category A returns and some dropped entities in the unpacking step.
- Success metrics (from the call): precision >= 92% on category A; mean latency < 300ms p50 for sampled traffic; no more than 1% broken parse rate.

Redwood recommended starting points (we discussed on call):
- Model candidates: redwood-3b-qa-quant (best latency/cost balance) and redwood-7b-finetune (higher quality for tricky cases).
- Prompt set: I attached the prompt_set we used in the demo (acme_prompt_set_v2.json) — includes the structured instruction templates and negative examples.
- Benchmarks: I linked our internal eval comparing v1.2 -> v1.3 (redwood_benchmarks_v1.3_vs_v1.2.pdf) and the live eval page in the related links.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) Permission to run a regression eval on the sample CSV you shared (regression_examples.csv) to produce a diff report (v1.2 vs v1.3) — takes ~4 business hours.
2) If the diff shows a regression on your key metrics, we can pin your production route to v1.2 (instant) while we triage. Pinning/rollback options were described in the docs — we’ll include a one-click rollback path for Dedicated customers.
3) If you approve, we’ll also run our recommended prompt adjustments (minor phrasing changes) and re-run the benchmark to quantify lift.
4) 30-min follow-up tomorrow to review findings and agree on rollback/timeline.

Please let me know if you want us to proceed with the regression run on your sample dataset. If you can confirm the required SLA for latency/precision in a reply, we’ll prioritize the eval.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: acme_prompt_set_v2.json, redwood_benchmarks_v1.3_vs_v1.2.pdf

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit & regression concerns after v1.3 rollout

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Please run the regression eval on our sample data (attached). A few specifics from what our SREs observed in production since the v1.3 rollout: both the parse/intent extraction failures and ordering issues. I’m pasting two short examples below (redacted):

Case 1 (expected parse):
- Input: "Customer returned item X, wants refund, order #12345"
- v1.2 output: "{ "intent": "refund", "order_id": "12345" }"
- v1.3 output: "{ "intent": "exchange", "order_id": "" }"

Case 2 (expected high-precision classification):
- Input: "Item arrived damaged, picture attached"
- v1.2 output: "category: Damage - Immediate return"
- v1.3 output: "category: Customer Service - Consult"

We’ve attached regression_examples.csv with ~250 rows; highlighted rows 12-24 show the worst failures.

We need the regression report and, if confirmed, a recommendation to pin/rollback promptly. Our ops team is ready to accept a pin to v1.2 for the route if you recommend it.

Thanks,
Taylor Nguyen
PM, Customer Experience | Acme Retail
---
Attachments: regression_examples.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@acme-retail.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit & regression concerns after v1.3 rollout

Thanks, Taylor — we received the CSV and I gave it a quick skim. Appreciate the concrete examples; that helps a lot. We’ll execute the regression eval now and aim to have a diff report back within the 4-hour window I mentioned.

Planned immediate actions:
- Run automated eval harness comparing v1.2 vs v1.3 on your 250-row sample; generate per-case diff + aggregate metrics (precision/recall by category, parse success rate, latency distributions).
- If the aggregate shows regression on your stated threshold (precision < 92% for category A or parse success < 99%), we’ll recommend pinning production to v1.2 immediately. For Dedicated customers we can pin the route via the Console (no deploy required); for Hosted we’ll coordinate a rollback deployment and a short maintenance window if needed.
- We’ll also test two small prompt adjustments from acme_prompt_set_v2.json that are low-risk (explicit extraction anchors) and include the before/after metrics in the report.

One note on pinning/rollback: pinning to v1.2 is reversible and doesn’t block future updates. It’s a thin guardrail while we triage. After the eval, if you want us to pin now, reply with "please pin to v1.2" and we’ll do it and notify your ops channel.

I’ll circulate the report and a recommended action in an internal triage thread and then loop you in. If you’re available for a 30-min sync at 10:30am PT tomorrow, I’ll book that.

– Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: planned_eval_config.yaml (internal), redwood_benchmarks_v1.3_vs_v1.2.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit & regression concerns after v1.3 rollout (internal triage)

Internal note / plan:
- I kicked off the eval job last night against ACME's CSV. Preliminary results: v1.3 shows a 7.4% drop in precision on category A (worse than threshold). Latency differences are negligible.
- Connor: can you scope a pin/rollback for Acme's production route? For Dedicated customers, pin is a route setting; I expect a ~5-min ops window. For Hosted, we’ll need a rollback deployment (ops + infra).
- Priority: pin route to v1.2 now to stop user-facing regression. I’ll prepare a short diff report and share with Marissa to forward to Taylor.

I’ll attach the diff CSV to the ticket and update the HubSpot deal once pin is applied.

Rishi
Head of Applied ML | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: diff_v1.2_v1.3_summary.csv (internal)
